subject: Order our chicken and eggs online 🐓 🥚
preview: Enjoy chicken and eggs from the farm all year round by ordering online for delivery or pickup.
body:
[PHOTO 1: the order page on a laptop, assets/images/online-ordering.png]

The markets are done for the year, and the tents are packed away. Our last few emails pointed you at the order page without saying much about how it works, so here's the tour. This summer was the first we sold our chicken, and we're grateful to everyone who tried it. Ordering online is how you keep buying from us without a market to meet at.

The order page at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/order/ has eggs by the dozen, whole chickens, cuts, and sausage, and it always shows what's in stock. Choose what you'd like, say how you want to get it, and pay. Your order is placed the moment the payment goes through, and we email you to confirm it.

There are three ways to get it:

DELIVERY
- Every {deliveryDay}, between {deliveryFrom} and {deliveryTo}
- Order by {cutoff}
- As affordable as we can make it: {minimum} minimum, {fee} fee

ON-FARM PICKUP
- {onfarmWhen}
- No fee, no minimum
- {farmAddress}

DROP-SITE PICKUP
- At one of our drop sites: every {dropDay} morning, {dropWindow}, at {dropPlace}{dropStarting}
- Markets and pop-ups we open for pickup show up on the order page too, each with its own place and time
- Pick up your order for free

Do we deliver to you? Check your ZIP code on the map at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/#map. We deliver across much of Rhode Island, and just over the line in Connecticut, where we can deliver eggs only for now. Our delivery policy lists every town: https://www.northfosterfarm.com/delivery-policy/

You don't need an account to order. If you'd like one, there's no password: type the email address you order with at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/login/ and we'll send you a link that signs you in. Signed in, you can see past orders and receipts, change or cancel an order in progress, and keep a delivery address on file.

The hens slow down when the days get short, but they keep laying, so there are eggs all year. Order whenever you run low.

This is the first version of our online ordering system, and we want to hear how it works for you. Just reply to this email if you run into any problems.

One more thing. Farm News, our email list, has moved to a new service, which is why this email may look different from our last few. You're still on the list, and we'll still write only every now and then: what's in stock, where to find us, and news from the pasture. We will never sell or give out your email address. If you'd rather not hear from us, the link at the bottom takes you off in one click. Know someone who'd like Farm News? They can sign up any time at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/news/, or tick the box when they place an order.

— James and Jim

---

You're getting this because you signed up for our email list at one of our markets or asked us by email. Unsubscribe in one click: {unsubscribeUrl}
